limitations: Single host. Guard observations were sampled, not continuous.

The Q4_K regression uses synthetic weights and activations at 256 and 512 rows; it checks all outputs across devices and three columns against an f64 CPU reference within an analytic quantization bound, not full model logits.

The Q8 timings are a weighted collection of isolated synthetic GEMMs on the RTX 3060, not end-to-end prefill or decode; the underlying timing test averages 20 launches per shape. The campaign was interrupted after one timing sample per binary and supports no speed claim.
This fix is a prerequisite for multi-device chunked prefill; it does not by itself implement or deploy that path.
